name: Fruit Clicker 🍎
desc:
🌱 Fruit Clicker 🍎 is a relaxing incremental idle clicker! 🌱

❓ How to play the game?
🍎 Click to gain Sheckles!
🔨 Upgrade to earn more Sheckles!
🌳 Collect even more Sheckles every second!
🥇 Become the richest Gardener on the Leaderboard!

💜 Thanks for playing!

The game uses fruit icons from the game Grow a Garden (Roblox open assets).

Ignore Tags: RNG, Garden Clicker, Evolution, Every Second, +1 Block, +1 Sheckle, Fruit Clicker, Clicker Simulator, Farm Clicker, Apple Clicker, Be a Tree, Currency Clicker, Garden Tycoon, Idle Garden Simulator

scripts.title: Opscripts Free Upgrades  Autoclicker
scripts.features:
-Main Tab-
Autoclicker - Toggles a autoclicker
-Free Upgrades Tab-
Cursor - Gives one free cursor upgrade
Spam Cursor - Spams the cursor upgrade
Autoclicker - Gives a autoclicker upgrade
Spam AutoClicker - spams the upgrade for autoclicker
A BUNCH of per click - gives you a bunch of cursor upgrades
A BUNCH of per second - gives you a bunch of autoclicker
A 10000x OF A BUNCH OF PER CLICK - the same as a bunch of per click but 10000x
A 10000x OF A BUNCH OF PER Second - Bunch of per second but 10 thousand times more.
Rebirth - requires the requirements, but rebirths
scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
local Window = Library.CreateLib("OpScripts - Fruit Clicker", "DarkTheme")
local Tab = Window:NewTab("Main")
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Main")
local Tab2 = Window:NewTab("Free Upgrades")
local Section2 = Tab2:NewSection("Free Upgrades")
Section:NewToggle("Autoclicker", "Autoclicker", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 20 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ClickEvent:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
end
end)
Section2:NewButton("Cursor", "Gives you one cursor upgrade", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerClick", 0, 1, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount", 1)
end)
Section2:NewToggle("Spam Cursor", "Spams Cursor Upgrade", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 20 do
		task.spawn(function()
				game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerClick", 0, 1, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount", 1)
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
	end
end)
Section2:NewButton("Autoclicker", "Gives you Autoclicker upgrade", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerSecond", 0, 1, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount", 1)
end)
Section2:NewToggle("Spam Auto Clicker", "Spams Auto Clicker Upgrade", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 20 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerSecond", 0, 1, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount", 1)
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
	end
end)
Section2:NewButton("A BUNCH of Per Click", "Gives you A BUNCH of Per Click", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerClick", 0, 1, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount", 90000000)
end)
Section2:NewButton("A BUNCH of Per Second", "Gives you A BUNCH of Per Second", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerSecond", 0, 1, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount", 90000000)
end)
Section2:NewButton("A 10000x OF A BUNCH of Per Click", "Gives you A BUNCH of Per Click", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerClick", 0, 1, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount", 900000000000)
end)
Section2:NewButton("A 10000x OF A BUNCH of Per Second", "Gives you A BUNCH of Per Second", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UpgradeEvent:FireServer("AmourPerSecond", 0, 1, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount", 900000000000)
end)
Section2:NewButton("Rebirth", "rebirth", function()
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").RebirthEvent:FireServer()
end)

scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Small = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClickEvent")
local Medium = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UpgradeEvent")
local Large = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RebirthEvent")
local EquipSkinEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RemoteEvents"):WaitForChild("EquipSkin")

_G.AutoSmall = true
_G.AutoMedium = true
_G.AutoLarge = true
_G.ExtraLarge = true

local bulkAmounts = {10, 50, 100, 500, 5000, 10000, 50000, 500000}

local skins = {
    "Strawberry", "Blueberry", "Orange Tulip", "Tomato", "Corn", "Daffodil",
    "Watermelon", "Pumpkin", "Bamboo", "Coconut", "Cactus", "Dragon Fruit",
    "Mango", "Grape", "Mushroom", "Pepper", "Cacao", "Beanstalk",
    "Ember Lily", "Sugar Apple", "Burning Bud", "Giant Pinecone",
    "Elder Strawberry", "Romanesco"
}

spawn(function()
    while _G.AutoSmall do
        Small:FireServer()
        task.wait()
    end
end)

spawn(function()
    while _G.AutoMedium do
        local clickUpgrades = {
            {"AmourPerClick", 50, 1, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 500, 5, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount2"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 12000, 100, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount3"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 90000, 1000, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount4"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 22000000, 9000, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount5"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 300000000, 25000, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount6"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 1800000000, 100000, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount7"},
            {"AmourPerClick", 2000000000000, 2000000, "AmourPerClickUpgrageCount8"},
        }

        for _, upgrade in ipairs(clickUpgrades) do
            for _, amount in ipairs(bulkAmounts) do
                Medium:FireServer(upgrade[1], upgrade[2], upgrade[3]*amount, upgrade[4])
            end
        end

        local secondUpgrades = {
            {"AmourPerSecond", 125, 1, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount"},
            {"AmourPerSecond", 1100, 6, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount2"},
            {"AmourPerSecond", 100000, 200, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount3"},
            {"AmourPerSecond", 315000, 5000, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount4"},
            {"AmourPerSecond", 81000000, 100000, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount5"},
            {"AmourPerSecond", 900000000, 200000, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount6"},
            {"AmourPerSecond", 3000000000, 15000000, "AmourPerSecondUpgrageCount7"},
        }

        for _, upgrade in ipairs(secondUpgrades) do
            for _, amount in ipairs(bulkAmounts) do
                Medium:FireServer(upgrade[1], upgrade[2], upgrade[3]*amount, upgrade[4])
            end
        end

        task.wait()
    end
end)

spawn(function()
    while _G.AutoLarge do
        Large:FireServer()
        task.wait()
    end
end)

spawn(function()
    while _G.ExtraLarge do
        for i = #skins, 1, -1 do
            local success = pcall(function()
                EquipSkinEvent:FireServer(skins[i], true)
            end)
            if success then
                break
            end
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end)
